capabilities.name: execution_guard
capabilities.adoption: SciCapsule and SciRust-Verify qualified compatible process-group and bounded-capture semantics. ProofLab qualified Bubblewrap/prlimit isolation, bounded ingestion, pinned Lean API and aggregate cgroup v2 budgets. RSI qualified default-deny Bubblewrap execution, full-snapshot Cargo workspace compatibility, delegated cgroup v2 aggregate RAM/PID/CPU-time budgets and multi-process CPU exhaustion. Forge now routes native candidate compilation and execution through a strict envelope and fails closed before spawn because its current POSIX backend is not a security boundary. Other consumers require their own versioned contracts and tests.

capabilities.name: numeric_invariants
capabilities.adoption: Forge SIMD/CUDA verification harnesses reject non-finite reference, output and difference values; CUDA uses a deterministic unwritten-output sentinel. FieldLab normalizes finite extremes and subnormals with scaled compensated sum-of-squares and rechecks unit norm. Both current main trees exactly match their green candidates. This is not yet a reusable cross-repository contract and does not qualify GPU hardware.
